jobs.title: SENIOR ASSOCIATE / LEGAL ADVISER AND PUBLIC PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP (PPP) MANAGER (MP-II)
jobs.description:
Required Educational Qualification and Experience:
Ph.D in Law with at least five (05) years' professional experience in the relevant field; OR a Master's degree in Law (LLM) with at least seven (07) years' professional experience in the relevant field.
Enrolment as an advocate is desirable.
Professional training in trade facilitation, customs, WTO agreements, PPP, contract negotiation or supply chain management is desirable.
Experience:
Relevant professional experience of five (05) years in case of holding Ph.D or seven (07) years in case of a Master’s degree in Law (LLM) in legal or regulatory matters relating to trade, customs, transport, logistics or allied fields, as prescribed under the MP-II eligibility criteria above. Experience shall include three (03) years in managing or advising on public-private partnerships or public-private dialogue in cross-border trade facilitation and/or supply chain management is desirable.
Core Competencies:
Strong legal drafting and analytical ability; negotiation and consensus-building; partnership and stakeholder management; strategic thinking and sound judgment; project and results-based management; digital literacy; excellent written and spoken communication; integrity, confidentiality and impartiality.
Age:
Maximum 62 Years as on the closing date of submission of application.
Period of Contract:
Initially for a period of three (03) years, extendable for another term of two (02) years (on yearly basis) upon satisfactory performance for each year and/or as per MP Policy as amended from time to time.
Other Details:
As per MP Scales Policy, 2020 Shortlisting criteria and ToRs of the vacancies, including relevant qualifications, relevant experience, job specifications, job descriptions, deliverables and timelines can be accessed /downloaded from the official website of Prime Minister’s Office www.pmo.gov.pk/career

jobs.title: TEAM LEADER / DEPUTY COORDINATOR / EXECUTIVE SECRETARY (MP-I)
jobs.description:
Required Educational Qualification and Experience:
Ph.D in International Trade, Economics, Public Policy, Law, Business Administration or another relevant subject, with at least seven (07) years' professional experience in the relevant field; OR a Master’s degree in any of these relevant subjects, with at least nine (09) years' experience in the relevant field.
Professional training in trade facilitation, customs, WTO agreements or supply chain management is desirable.
Experience:
Relevant post qualification experience (trade policy, customs, trade facilitation or related public sector/private-sector work) shall be at least seven (07) years for candidates holding a relevant Ph.D or nine (09) years for candidates holding a relevant Master's degree. Demonstrated progressive experience in trade policy, customs, trade facilitation, cross-border trade or related public/private sector work, including more than five (05) years’ experience in senior management or team leadership, is desirable.
Core Competencies:
Strategic leadership; negotiation and consensus-building; analytical and report-writing ability; project and results-based management; digital literacy; excellent written and spoken communication; integrity and impartiality.
Age:
Maximum 62 Years as on the closing date of submission of application.
Period of Contract:
Initially for a period of three (03) years, extendable for another term of two (02) years (on yearly basis) upon satisfactory performance of each year and/or as per MP Policy as amended from time to time.
Other Details:
As per MP Scales Policy, 2020 Shortlisting criteria and ToRs of the vacancies, including relevant qualifications, relevant experience, job specifications, job descriptions, deliverables and timelines can be accessed /downloaded from the official website of Prime Minister’s Office www.pmo.gov.pk/career
